title: The Summit of the Coral Triangle
author: Tamsin Halloran
blurb: Coral Crane, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
